references.text: God declares himself as the Lord who brought Israel out of Egypt and commands that they have no other gods.
The warning not to follow other gods, the gods of the nations living around them.
Joshua's call for Israel to fear the Lord and serve him, and to reject the gods of the Amorites.
Israel did not obey the Lord's commands and statutes; they did not listen to his voice.
God reminds them of the covenant and complains that the people neither listened to his voice nor inclined their ear.
The prophecy that Israel will turn to other gods, despise the Lord, and not listen to his voice.
God urges Israel not to worship foreign gods but complains that they did not listen to his voice.
